policy.effect_direction: signed original gene DESeq2 log2(cKO / WT)
policy.complex_rule: Every ligand AND every receptor complex subunit is an unambiguous DEG at its exact matching sender or receiver endpoint
policy.native_rank_rule: Original complete-universe LIANA scores and ranks are retained; no rank recomputation after DEG selection
policy.total_inhibitory_fit: Excluded because IN_Total is not one of the five requested endpoints

nodes.label: IN C8
nodes.zero_strict_interactions_reason: Calb1 is the sole saved C8 DEG (up in cKO); it is absent from mouseconsensus ligand/receptor subunits, so C8 has zero strict resource-supported interactions. This is not an omitted analysis or proof of no communication.

provenance.scorer: LIANA 2.0.0 native rank aggregate with native CellPhoneDB scorer
provenance.normalization: Raw duplicate-symbol RNA counts summed before log1p(CP10k), using full 32,285-feature library denominator; 32,245 collapsed genes
provenance.source_memberships: Frozen Seurat original_full molecular CA1 deep/superficial programs and inhibitory C1/C6/C8; IN_Total and every other inhibitory endpoint are excluded

score_semantics.lr_logfc: Native cell-group-versus-rest specificity; not cKO/WT log2 fold change
score_semantics.lr_gmeans: Geometric mean of endpoint means of log-normalized expression, using native complex bottleneck rules
score_semantics.magnitude_rank: Lower consensus magnitude rank indicates higher priority; not a genotype P value or FDR
score_semantics.specificity_rank: Native aggregate cell-context specificity rank; not genotype evidence
score_semantics.cellphone_pvals: Native LIANA CellPhoneDB cell-label specificity P; zero is below empirical 1/1000 resolution
score_semantics.lr_prop: Minimum detection fraction over every ligand and receptor complex subunit; clamp only for plotting
score_semantics.ligand_props: Detection fraction of native mean-expression-limiting ligand subunit; may differ from all-subunit minimum
score_semantics.receptor_props: Detection fraction of native mean-expression-limiting receptor subunit; may differ from all-subunit minimum
score_semantics.deg_supported: Every retained ligand and receptor subunit is a matching endpoint DEG (not the legacy OR policy)
score_semantics.sample_support: Expression-gate support among eligible independent mice, with eligible denominators retained
score_semantics.ligand_deg_direction: Original sender endpoint gene DESeq2 sign: positive log2(cKO/WT)=up; negative=down
score_semantics.receptor_deg_direction: Original receiver endpoint gene DESeq2 sign: positive log2(cKO/WT)=up; negative=down
score_semantics.deg_direction_pair: Ordered ligand→receptor gene effect directions. This is not a signed interaction activity change.

interpretation_caveats: Genotype effects belong to component genes in the original mouse-level DESeq2 fit, including when viewing WT-only or cKO-only native scores; no genotype interaction test was fitted.
Native lr_logfc remains group-versus-rest specificity, not genotype fold change. Scores and ranks were not refitted or reranked using a DEG-only background.
Deep/superficial are molecular expression programs, not measured physical layers. C8 has an identity-review flag.
Calb1 is C8's sole DEG and absent from mouseconsensus. Zero retained C8 interactions is not proof that C8 does not communicate.

RNA/prior-compatible LR candidates do not establish contact, functional synapses, receptor activation, inhibition or net activity. Reversed Nrxn/Nlgn resource orientations are not independent physiological routes.
provenance.selection_policy: DEG-only: all ligand and receptor complex subunits must be unambiguous padj<0.05 genes in their exact matching sender/receiver DESeq2 endpoints; only CA1 Deep/Superficial and IN C1/C6/C8
provenance.derivation: Corrected strict projection of completed native pooled/WT/cKO IN_clusters fits. Full-gene expression normalization, scoring background, ranks and all native scientific source files remain unchanged. No refits or expression recomputation.

c8_result: Calb1 is the sole saved C8 DEG (up in cKO); it is absent from mouseconsensus ligand/receptor subunits, so C8 has zero strict resource-supported interactions. This is not an omitted analysis or proof of no communication.
components_layout: components[population_id][complex_name] gives significant matching endpoint subunits only. Gene log2FoldChange/padj are read directly from byte-verified original stable-ID DESeq2 audits, avoiding rounded historical JSON transport values.
